summary: Inaugural session of spectral-attribution. The log is instituted before the root commit, so that no work of this session sits outside it. The apparatus was written first and left untracked, so that the root commit can hold the preregistration alone.

Dash gate, effort log, figure gate, untouchable gate, gate runner, hook installer and test suite written and installed. Reused by reading from the closed prior lane, with provenance declared, and extended with tests this lane needs.

The signed design written: the question, the signal and the bit convention quoted from the deposit at its tag, the selection bias, the two nulls, the attribution as primary quantity, the refutation criterion with its failability checked in both directions, multiplicity, sample size, seed, and what will not be claimed.

Figure registry opened with the figures this lane is most likely to repeat by reflex: the two the audited footnote prints, the four of the auditor's unregistered exploration, its draw count, and the two constants this lane derived by hand and has not executed. Every one is unusable in a commit message until an artefact here produces it.
Root commit made. Its tree holds one path and the working tree held the apparatus untracked, which is declared rather than tidied.

Contact rules written: the deposit under audit read only at its tag, the closed lane read only at its final head and not citable, the two deposited neighbours read only at their tags, the untouchable lane, birth with no remote, and the manifest rule for files this lane did not produce.

Term gate run with declared queries. The name is occupied by exact string as a public repository and as a compound term of art in machine learning interpretability. Rename recommended, decision left open and belonging to Alexis.

Provenance of the reused apparatus declared, with the commit read, the digest of every file read, what changed in each, and the reason the sampler is reimplemented from the signed definition rather than copied.

The untouchable gate refused its own test suite on the first real run: the new pattern tests named an untouchable repository as a literal. Fixed by building every fixture from the tool's own list at run time, not by exempting the enforcer. Nothing entered the history.

Standing documents opened: the reference list with a verification status on every entry, the background review declared unstarted with its future scope fixed now, the manifest with no contents and one anticipated entry, and the decision register with nothing decided and four decisions named as belonging to Alexis.

Two route validation declared before any sampler exists: the published membership predicate read at its deposit tag, and five exact facts fixed in the signed document. Tolerances, stop rules, the order of operations and the inheritance accounting from the closed lane are all fixed here.
Defect register opened with four entries, the first of them a contradiction inside the signed preregistration found by reading it against itself.

Rigour report for the inaugural session written: commits, files, the state of the chain, both history sweeps, the figure gate exercised against this lane's own temptations, what the signed design commits the lane to, what the declared prior costs, and the four decisions that belong to Alexis.

Session one closed. Nothing measured: no sampler exists in this repository, no draw was taken from either null family, and the received sequence has not been read in. Eight commits, no remote, four defects recorded, four decisions open.

Second session. Head at open is 1fd6ecf98d2344b146754e1dabc83758f9e40bde, the inaugural close, working tree clean, twenty-four tracked paths, no remote, root tree holding one path and the preregistration blob unchanged from root to head.

Four decisions of Alexis recorded with decider and date: the name is walsh-attribution, a remote is authorised under the house procedure, the artefacts stay in English, and the deflationary expected shape of the lane is accepted. The term gate measurement that produced the rename is left intact and the signed preregistration is not amended.

Two errata candidates prepared for the deposit under audit and applied nowhere: the signal the footnote describes against the one its verifier computes, and the clause naming the even orders against a baseline and a share both computed over orders two and four. Each carries the literal prose, the file and lines of the code at the same tag, and a one sentence correction. Nothing in that package was touched and no branch of it was opened.

The sampler, the transform and the neighbour reader written from the signed definitions. Nothing here reads the received sequence and no aggregate over the focal orders is formed for any draw of the pair preserving family.

Both routes run and both pass. The published predicate and the closed lane's predicate agree with this lane's on every draw and on every witness. All four hand derived facts of the signed document hold, including the exact order six mean under the pair preserving family and the invariance across the four bit conventions, so the declared test set has seven members and one convention is carried.
Two defects added: the validation plan fixed a tolerance without fixing the draw counts, and an acceptance test was briefly written against a bound on its own standard error, which loosens it.
Pre publication sweep tool added for the house procedure of the remote rule, with its patterns and its named allowance mechanism taken from the closed lane and recorded in the provenance file.

Rigour report for session two: the four decisions and what each left alone, the two errata candidates, both validation routes with what each establishes, the figure registry movement, the house procedure with its three steps, and the one pending item, which is that the repository on the forge does not exist yet.

Session two closed. The focal statistic was not computed and the received sequence has not entered. Both validation routes pass, all four hand derived facts of the signed document hold, the four decisions are recorded, two errata candidates are prepared and applied nowhere, and the push is pending only on the forge repository being created.

Third session. Head at open is 6b6a3bdd, the session two close, working tree clean, thirty-one tracked paths, no remote, root tree holding one path and the preregistration blob unchanged from root to head.

Staleness gate for the validation added and tested by breaking it. The result file now records the digest of every module the validation is a statement about, and the gate refuses a commit when any of them has moved, naming the file. This closes by mechanism the weakness session two reported about itself.

House procedure re-run over the history as it stood: one line log of fourteen commits, sweep of fifty-one distinct text blobs with one file allowed by name and no findings, remote confirmed empty by ls-remote before it was attached. Remote attached and the history pushed at 2026-08-11T22:35:04Z, returning at 22:35:06Z. Local head, remote head and both trees identical. Repository public. The observed value has not been read.
The two contracts updated to record the executed publication and to restate that the authorisation does not extend to later pushes.

The received King Wen sequence transcribed mechanically from the deposit at its tag, checked on entry for sixty-four distinct six bit values, and recorded in the manifest with the digest of the source file and of the file written.

The declared analysis run once at the fixed sample size and seed. Both preconditions pass. The full profile by order is the primary report, the focal share is the preespecified statistic, the attribution is computed under the definition fixed in the signed document, the seven declared tests are Holm corrected over the whole set, and the signed criterion is met in its refutation branch.

Rigour report for session three: the ordering with its clock, the push with its address, visibility, both heads and both trees, the fifth gate tested by breaking it, the transcription, the measurement in brief, what the profile showed that the focal statistic conceals, and the one figure that can never be unblocked.

Session three closed. The signed preregistration was published to a public remote and the push returned before the observed value was read. Both preconditions passed, the attribution puts about a third of the excess on the pair rule and about two thirds off it, and the signed criterion was met in its refutation branch.

Fourth session, and the last of this lane. Local head at open is 1effff0, the session three close; remote head is da4b5d1, three commits behind; working tree clean, thirty-eight tracked paths, root tree holding one path and the preregistration blob unchanged from root to head.

House procedure re-run over what was new: one line log of the three commits, sweep of sixty-four distinct text blobs across the whole history and of thirty-seven files in the working tree, one file allowed by name, no findings. Pushed at 2026-08-11T22:52:31Z. Both heads and both trees identical afterwards.

Third errata candidate added, resting on the measurement rather than on a reading, with the sentence the document used to carry reproduced and retired rather than deleted. The order two observation given its own section in the results, with its uncorrected p, the fact that it does not survive the declared correction, and the two reasons this lane records it and stops.
